name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels, excluding electric bicycles and mopeds: an electric two- or three-wheeler faster than 30 mph within a mile is one, and over 5 horsepower (3,750 W) it's no longer a motor-driven cycle.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground
No upper limit on motor power or speed; one of 5 horsepower (3,750 W) or less is also a motor-driven cycle
Riders need a motorcycle license or endorsement, or a motorcycle learner's permit
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet
Riders need eyeglasses, goggles or a face shield unless a windshield protects their eyes and face
Registered with a permit from the city or town and a state plate
A motorized two- or three-wheeler that isn't a motorcycle, motor-driven cycle or moped can be registered only with proof it meets federal motor vehicle safety standards
Used for off-highway recreation, even a registered motorcycle is an off highway recreational vehicle
